name: ANTICIPATE
definition: Maintain a state of informed preparedness in order to forestall compromises of mission/ business functions from adversary attacks.
source_document: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_CSC_EXT/P/CIR/2024/113 dated August 20, 2024 — Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs), Version 1.0 (KB 2/India/SEBI Cybersecurity & Cyber Resilience Framework.pdf)

name: WITHSTAND
definition: Continue essential mission/business functions despite successful execution of an attack by an adversary.
source_document: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_CSC_EXT/P/CIR/2024/113 dated August 20, 2024 — Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs), Version 1.0 (KB 2/India/SEBI Cybersecurity & Cyber Resilience Framework.pdf)

name: CONTAIN
definition: Localize containment of crisis and isolate trusted systems from untrusted systems to continue essential business operations in the event of cyber-attacks.
source_document: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_CSC_EXT/P/CIR/2024/113 dated August 20, 2024 — Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs), Version 1.0 (KB 2/India/SEBI Cybersecurity & Cyber Resilience Framework.pdf)

name: RECOVER
definition: Restore mission/ business functions to the maximum extent possible, subsequent to successful execution of an attack by an adversary.
source_document: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_CSC_EXT/P/CIR/2024/113 dated August 20, 2024 — Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs), Version 1.0 (KB 2/India/SEBI Cybersecurity & Cyber Resilience Framework.pdf)

name: EVOLVE
definition: To change mission/ business functions and/or the supporting cyber capabilities, so as to minimize adverse impacts from actual or predicted adversary attacks.
source_document: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_CSC_EXT/P/CIR/2024/113 dated August 20, 2024 — Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities (REs), Version 1.0 (KB 2/India/SEBI Cybersecurity & Cyber Resilience Framework.pdf)
